originalTitle: Cloudflare, MongoDB, Datadog, JFrog, and Elastic shares plummet, what you need to know
summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after software stocks extended the selloff from the previous session as investors continued to reprice valuations amid mounting artificial intelligence capital expenditure concerns and decelerating software bookings.
content:
A number of stocks fell in the morning session after software stocks extended the selloff from the previous session as investors continued to reprice valuations amid mounting artificial intelligence capital expenditure concerns and decelerating software bookings.

Oracle filed to raise $20 billion in debt and equity, reigniting concerns over soaring artificial intelligence spending and cash burn.The selloff deepened after quarterly reports from Alphabet and Amazon highlighted soaring data-center outlays that compressed free cash flows, as reported by Bloomberg. That spending concern triggered the tech-heavy Nasdaq's drop the previous week, cementing its steepest monthly decline in over a year, according to The Wall Street Journal.

Investors are increasingly demanding clear evidence that massive infrastructure outlays will translate into sustainable profits and robust revenue growth. Without immediate monetization from enterprise adoption, concerns over elevated sector valuations have deepened, leading to broad-based selling pressure across chipmakers, hardware providers, and cloud service operators.

The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.

Among others, the following stocks were impacted:

Data storage company MongoDB(NASDAQ:MDB) fell 3.5%. Is now the time to buy MongoDB? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

Cloud monitoring company Datadog(NASDAQ:DDOG) fell 4.4%. Is now the time to buy Datadog? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

Developer operations company JFrog(NASDAQ:FROG) fell 5.7%. Is now the time to buy JFrog? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

Data infrastructure company Elastic(NYSE:ESTC) fell 4.6%. Is now the time to buy Elastic? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

JFrog's shares are extremely volatile and have had 45 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today's move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 3 days ago when the stock dropped 8.8% on the news that underwhelming earnings reports from tech giants Amazon and Intel (after mediocre earnings reports from Alphabet and ServiceNow the previous day) sparked widespread investor anxiety regarding aggressive artificial intelligence spending and sustained cash burn.

As reported by CNBC, disappointing quarterly reports from both companies triggered a broad slide across technology equities and hardware suppliers, overshadowing positive momentum in other areas of the market. Investors grew increasingly wary of the sector's rising capital expenditures—the funds poured into long-term assets such as data centers and computing hardware. With both firms spending heavily to build out artificial intelligence infrastructure, market participants are questioning when these massive investments will translate into meaningful revenue and profit growth per CNBC.

The steep drops in Amazon and Intel weighed heavily on market indices, showing how vulnerabilities among dominant technology leaders can rapidly dampen confidence across the broader industry.

JFrog is up 48.7% since the beginning of the year, but at $88.55 per share, it is still trading 14.9% below its 52-week high of $104.03 from August 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of JFrog's shares 5 years ago would now be looking at an investment worth $2,692.

chineseTitle: Cloudflare、MongoDB、Datadog、JFrog 和 Elastic 股价暴跌，你需要知道什么
chineseSummary: 由于投资者对人工智能资本支出担忧加剧和软件预订放缓，投资者继续重新定价估值，软件股延续前一交易日的抛售，许多股票早盘下跌。
chineseContent:
由于投资者对人工智能资本支出担忧加剧和软件预订放缓，投资者继续重新定价估值，软件股延续前一交易日的抛售，许多股票早盘下跌。

甲骨文申请筹集 200 亿美元的债务和股权，重新引发人们对人工智能支出飙升和现金消耗的担忧。据彭博社报道，Alphabet 和亚马逊的季度报告强调数据中心支出飙升，压缩了自由现金流，导致抛售加剧。据《华尔街日报》报道，这种支出担忧引发了以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上周下跌，巩固了一年多来最大幅度的月度跌幅。

投资者越来越需要明确的证据来证明大规模的基础设施支出将转化为可持续的利润和强劲的收入增长。如果不能立即从企业采用中获利，对行业估值上升的担忧就会加深，导致芯片制造商、硬件提供商和云服务运营商面临广泛的抛售压力。

股市对消息反应过度，价格大幅下跌可能是购买优质股票的好机会。

其中，以下股票受到影响：

云监控公司Datadog（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）下跌4.4%。现在是购买 Datadog 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

开发者运营公司 JFrog（纳斯达克股票代码：FROG）下跌 5.7%。现在是购买 JFrog 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

数据基础设施公司 Elastic (NYSE:ESTC) 下跌 4.6%。现在是购买 Elastic 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

JFrog 的股价波动极大，去年有 45 次涨幅超过 5%。在这种背景下，今天的举动表明市场认为这一消息有意义，但不会从根本上改变其对该业务的看法。

我们之前写到的重大变动是在 3 天前，当时科技巨头亚马逊和英特尔的盈利报告表现不佳（前一天 Alphabet 和 ServiceNow 的盈利报告表现平平），引发了投资者对激进的人工智能支出和持续现金消耗的普遍焦虑，导致该股下跌 8.8%。

据 CNBC 报道，两家公司令人失望的季度报告引发了科技股和硬件供应商的广泛下滑，掩盖了市场其他领域的积极势头。投资者对该行业不断增长的资本支出越来越警惕——资金涌入数据中心和计算硬件等长期资产。据 CNBC 报道，随着两家公司投入巨资建设人工智能基础设施，市场参与者质疑这些巨额投资何时能转化为有意义的收入和利润增长。

亚马逊和英特尔的大幅下跌严重影响了市场指数，表明主导技术领导者的漏洞如何迅速削弱整个行业的信心。

JFrog 自今年年初以来上涨了 48.7%，但以每股 88.55 美元的价格计算，仍比 2026 年 8 月以来的 52 周高点 104.03 美元低 14.9%。五年前购买了价值 1,000 美元 JFrog 股票的投资者现在将考虑价值 2,692 美元的投资。

还有一件事：华尔街忘记了 21 美元的人工智能应用股票。当华尔街热衷于谁在开发人工智能时，一家公司已经在使用它来印钞票。而且没有人关注。
